title: Power Rankings: Trade gives Heat boost
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Preseason
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The Rockets' official team marketing slogan this season: 'It's Time.' After 10 seasons without winning a playoff series -- for Houston as a franchise and T-Mac individually -- I'd say it's a unanimous sentiment.

rankings.summaryHtml: Boston is just getting started with an all-new team, Chicago is still growing up, Miami is aging and Cleveland is not exactly getting deeper around LeBron James. So here's our advice, Pistons: Capitalize while you can.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Cinderella feel of Utah's playoff run didn't quite make it to training camp, but there's still plenty of talent here to offset any turbulence. Even in the face of expectations that some fear are too high now.

rankings.summaryHtml: Allen Iverson says his Nuggets are capable of winning 60 games. I can't go that high, but the only record that really matters is significantly sprucing up their 3-12 playoff mark in the George Karl era.

rankings.summaryHtml: The sad reality, after all the chaos of the summer and October, is that this team is in for a real drop if Kobe leaves and a ride of countless bumps and ceaseless speculation just to grab a playoff spot if he stays.

rankings.summaryHtml: Even if we ignore all the off-court sideshows, plenty of on-court uncertainty remains. Chemistry, leadership and defense are all in question, as well as the compatibility of Curry, Randolph and fan-favorite D-Lee.

rankings.summaryHtml: No misprint: Atlanta is your preseason champion after going 7-1 in exhibition play. What does that mean in real life? Losing has become such a habit here that, sorry, we are still required to advise extreme caution..

rankings.summaryHtml: The Pacers, last season's worst-shooting team, made minimal personnel changes and hired a coach who has always relied heavily on shooters. So we'll need to see more than a 6-2 preseason for a lasting jump.
